findings.failure_path: The unrestricted 'defer it with a reason' disposition can clear a confirmed P0/P1 without repair evidence or source refutation. The plan's Failure boundary explicitly includes 'a reason' among sufficient dispositions. An agent can therefore defer a real P1 after the last pass and omit its blocking status, contrary to acceptance.
findings.smallest_fix: State that deferral alone never clears confirmed P0/P1: they remain blocking until supported repair or refutation evidence exists, subject to any separately authorized waiver.

findings.failure_path: After two passes, the reminder prohibits further reviewer calls except for a P0/P1 fix. It omits the canonical rule that new behavior or scope requires its own review and challenge. Adding ordinary implementation behavior after the challenge therefore triggers instructions to self-dispose it instead of obtaining the owed passes.
findings.smallest_fix: Limit the stop instruction to finding-only fixes and explicitly require review plus challenge for new behavior or scope; add a hook probe pinning that exception.

findings.failure_path: The document exemption is unqualified by lane or behavioral effect. Operational Markdown such as skill policies or agent instructions is non-executable on disk but controls agent behavior. Changing such guidance after challenge can be classified as exempt documentation, bypassing the extraction lane's requirement to review later changes beyond non-executable evidence records.
findings.smallest_fix: Restrict these exemptions to daily development and exclude behavior-governing instructions, operational recipes and other owner-gated changes. Preserve the extraction lane's narrower evidence-record exemption explicitly.

findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: the packet supplies flag recipes and string pins, but no controller source or executed transition demonstrating review → changed candidate → standalone challenge → evidence-only disposition without another call or human decision. The included receipt records completion gating and human_decision_required=true. It also permits dirty candidates while prescribing a delta base that requires a challenged commit. The bounded evidence cannot establish that this workflow terminates as promised.
findings.smallest_fix: Supply controller excerpts and deterministic transition evidence covering changed and uncommitted candidates, post-challenge disposition, the final P0/P1 delta pass and preserved owner gates; correct any incompatible recipe exposed.

challenge_focus: Attack the daily-development review budget: one review, one challenge on the fixed candidate, one delta pass only for a post-challenge P0/P1 fix, then agent disposition. Hunt paths where a real defect reaches a ready report unreviewed: severity downgraded to dodge the delta pass, new behavior disguised as a fix, a test-only or doc-only exemption that hides a behavior change, a high-risk change not tagged so it falls into the daily budget, and conflicts with the skill-extraction lane, the PR hook reminder, the always-on line or the continuation checkpoint. Also check whether the budget can turn into a stop-and-ask or into endless reruns.
